_meta.description: Latest available socio-economic/workforce indicators for Andhra Pradesh — sourced from the AP Government's own 'Socio Economic Survey 2024-25' (Finance Department, apfinance.gov.in), General Overview chapter, which itself cites PLFS (Periodic Labour Force Survey) 2023-24 data. This REPLACES the earlier Census-2011 district-level worker-classification proxy, which was 14 years stale.
_meta.source: Andhra Pradesh Socio Economic Survey 2024-25 (Govt. of AP, Finance Dept.), citing PLFS 2023-24
_meta.granularity_note: IMPORTANT TRADE-OFF: this source publishes STATE-LEVEL figures only — it does not break workforce/sector composition down by district or constituency. Census 2011 did offer district-level splits but was 14 years old. This is the most current AP-government-published figure available; every AC will show the same statewide numbers until a district/AC-level current source is found.
